description: Merge params into the open feature edit session (feature sheet, helper edit card, or hole card). Keys depend on the feature kind; for a move, params.at (a list_bodies centroid) re-points it and dx / dy / dz change the offset. Confirm with confirm_feature.

params.description: Feature sheet / edit-card fields to merge before confirm. Keys depend on the feature kind (e.g. height, radius, distance). For a move: dx, dy, dz, and at.

at.description: Move only: new body centroid [x, y, z] mm from list_bodies; re-points the move

name: edit_feature
